acceptanceCriteria: Every `dogfood status` and `dogfood finish` result either carries at least one next action or a named reason code for having none, covered by a test for the frontier-UNAVAILABLE case.
The local-completion spec states the requirement with a stable ID traced to that test.
body: `internal/localcompletion/types.go` carries `NextActions` with `omitempty`. Lesson 40 of the source holds that a handoff without a next action is a status report. The session-start event observed 2026-09-24 reported `frontier: UNAVAILABLE (frontier-authority-unavailable)` with no next action. Whether finish and status always populate NextActions is not yet confirmed. Source: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch, Phase 14 agent-workbench track, reviewed 2026-09-24.
